title: Chicken Kabsa (Spiced Rice with Chicken)
description: Chicken Kabsa is a traditional Arabic rice dish made with roasted chicken and fragrant basmati rice cooked in a rich blend of spices, tomatoes, and aromatic stock. It is a festive, flavorful dish commonly served on large platters for sharing.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Marinade
items: 1 whole chicken (about 1.5–2 kg), cut into pieces

ingredients.title: For the Rice
items: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked in water 30 min
1 tsp ground black lime (loomi) or ½ tsp dried lime powder

instruction.title: Instructions
steps:
1. Marinate and Roast the Chicken:
• Combine chicken with olive oil, salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, and cardamom. Rub well.
• Marinate at least 1 hour or overnight.
• Preheat oven to 200°C (390°F).
• Roast chicken for 35–40 minutes until golden and cooked through.
• Reserve chicken stock from roasting pan or deglaze with water.

2. Prepare the Rice:
• Rinse soaked rice until water runs clear.
• Heat ghee in a large pot and sauté onions until golden.
• Add garlic, tomatoes, and carrot; cook 3–5 minutes.
• Add whole spices (cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf) and sauté 1 minute.
• Add ground spices and stir until fragrant.

3. Cook the Rice:
• Add chicken stock (enough to cover rice by 1–2 cm).
• Bring to a boil, add rice, and mix gently.
• Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15–20 minutes until cooked.
• Rest 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

4. Assemble the Kabsa:
• Arrange rice on a large platter.
• Place roasted chicken on top.
• Garnish with toasted almonds, pine nuts, parsley, and optional raisins.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with Arabic salad or yogurt sauce
Pair with pickles and fresh lemon wedges
Enjoy as a festive shared meal
Serve on a large platter for traditional presentation

chefTips: Ghee adds richer aroma compared to oil.
Homemade chicken stock significantly improves flavor depth.
Always toast nuts before garnishing for crunch and authenticity.
Layering spices at different stages builds deeper flavor complexity.
Serve on a wide platter for traditional communal dining style.
